title: Noradrenaline Synergistically Enhances Porphyromonas gingivalis LPS and OMV-Induced Interleukin-1beta Production in BV-2 Microglia Through Differential Mechanisms.
authors: Muramoto, Sakura; Shimizu, Sachi; Shirakawa, Sumika; Ikeda, Honoka; Miyamoto, Sayaka; Jo, Misato; Takemori, Uzuki; Morimoto, Chiharu; Wu, Zhou; Tozaki-Saitoh, Hidetoshi; Oda, Kosuke; Inoue, Erika; Nonaka, Saori; Nakanishi, Hiroshi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究去甲肾上腺素增强牙龈卟啉单胞菌LPS/OMV诱导小胶质细胞IL-1β产生的机制，涉及NF-κB与AP-1转录因子协同结合DNA，并用AlphaFold2建模，但核心是炎症信号通路而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上仅结构预测辅助，故为中档。
abstract: Infection with Porphyromonas gingivalis (Pg), which is a major periodontal pathogen, causes a large number of systemic diseases based on chronic inflammation such as diabetes and Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, it is not yet fully understood how Pg can augment local systemic immune and inflammatory responses during progression of AD. There is a strong association between depression and elevated levels of inflammation. Noradrenaline (NA) is a key neurotransmitter that modulates microglial activation during stress conditions. In this study, we have thus investigated the regulatory mechanisms of NA on the production of interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) by microglia following stimulation with Pg virulence factors, lipopolysaccharide (LPS), and outer membrane vesicles (OMVs). NA (30-1000 nM) significantly enhanced the mRNA level, promoter activity, and protein level of IL-1beta up to 20-fold in BV-2 microglia following treatment with Pg LPS (10 mug/mL) and OMVs (150 mug of protein/mL) in a dose-dependent manner. Pharmacological studies have suggested that NA synergistically augments the responses induced by Pg LPS and OMVs through different mechanisms. AP-1 is activated by the beta(2) adrenergic receptor (Abeta(2)R)-mediated pathway. NF-kappaB, which is activated by the Pg LPS/toll-like receptor 2-mediated pathway, is required for the synergistic effect of NA on the Pg LPS-induced IL-1beta production by BV-2 microglia. Co-immunoprecipitation combined with Western blotting and the structural models generated by AlphaFold2 suggested that cross-coupling of NF-kappaB p65 and AP-1 c-Fos transcription factors enhances the binding of NF-kappaB p65 to the IkappaB site, resulting in the synergistic augmentation of the IL-1beta promoter activity. In contrast, OMVs were phagocytosed by BV-2 microglia and then activated the TLR9/p52/RelB-mediated pathway. The Abeta(2)R/Epac-mediated pathway, which promotes phagosome maturation, may be responsible for the synergistic effect of NA on the OMV-induced production of IL-1beta in BV-2 microglia. Our study provides the first evidence that NA synergistically enhances the production of IL-1beta in response to Pg LPS and OMVs through distinct mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 感染牙龈卟啉单胞菌（Porphyromonas gingivalis, Pg）——一种主要的牙周病原体——会基于慢性炎症引发大量全身性疾病，如糖尿病和阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）。然而，Pg如何在AD进展过程中增强局部全身免疫和炎症反应尚未完全阐明。抑郁症与炎症水平升高之间存在密切关联。去甲肾上腺素（Noradrenaline, NA）是一种关键神经递质，在应激条件下调节小胶质细胞活化。在本研究中，我们探讨了NA对Pg毒力因子脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）和外膜囊泡（outer membrane vesicles, OMVs）刺激后小胶质细胞产生白细胞介素-1β（interleukin-1beta, IL-1beta）的调控机制。NA（30-1000 nM）在Pg LPS（10 μg/mL）和OMVs（150 μg蛋白/mL）处理后，显著增强BV-2小胶质细胞中IL-1beta的mRNA水平、启动子活性和蛋白水平，最高达20倍，且呈剂量依赖性。药理学研究表明，NA通过不同机制协同增强Pg LPS和OMVs诱导的反应。AP-1通过β2肾上腺素能受体（β(2) adrenergic receptor, Aβ(2)R）介导的通路被激活。NF-κB通过Pg LPS/Toll样受体2介导的通路被激活，是NA对Pg LPS诱导的BV-2小胶质细胞IL-1beta产生产生协同效应所必需的。免疫共沉淀结合Western blotting以及AlphaFold2生成的结构模型表明，NF-κB p65和AP-1 c-Fos转录因子的交叉偶联增强了NF-κB p65与IκB位点的结合，从而导致IL-1beta启动子活性的协同增强。相比之下，OMVs被BV-2小胶质细胞吞噬后，激活了TLR9/p52/RelB介导的通路。Aβ(2)R/Epac介导的通路促进吞噬体成熟，可能负责NA对OMV诱导的BV-2小胶质细胞IL-1beta产生的协同效应。我们的研究首次提供证据表明，NA通过不同机制协同增强对Pg LPS和OMVs的IL-1beta产生。
